title: 🎁 Invitation Activities
summary: Invite your friends and get bonuses

content:
📋 Activity Rules:

title: 💰 Fixed Salary and Tax Subsidy
summary: Receive a fixed salary based on the number of VIP members in your team
content:
📋 Activity Rules:

  • A fixed salary is distributed once a month on the 1st day (UTC).
  • After meeting the tax subsidy criteria, you can request the subsidy fund during each successful cash-out period.
  • This benefit is permanent – the more members you have, the higher your salary payment will be.
  • Only VIP-level members within the team are counted.

title: 🧠 PG Knowledge Quiz Challenge
summary: Participate every Tuesday, Thursday, and Sunday to win cash prizes
time: Every Tuesday, Thursday, and Sunday afternoon at 19:00 UTC (1:00 AM Ethiopian time)
content:
📢 Activity Announcement — PG Knowledge Quiz Challenge

To thank everyone for their active participation, our online quiz activity has officially been upgraded! Clear rules, generous prizes – everyone is welcome to join on time:

⏰ Activity Time: Every Tuesday, Thursday, and Sunday afternoon at 19:00 UTC (1:00 AM Ethiopian time)

📝 Activity Rules: A total of 10 questions. Speed and accuracy are what make you a winner!

💰 Prize Details: The top three who answer correctly will each receive an immediate 30 ETB cash prize! (If you get all correct, you can receive up to 300 ETB in total)

Spots are limited – it's all about your knowledge and speed! We recommend setting a reminder in advance. We look forward to seeing you win gold. See you there!

title: 🎟️ PG-MALL Large Cash Voucher Lucky Draw
summary: Participate with 20 ETB and win big cash vouchers (up to 8 winners)
time: Voucher orders can be purchased every Sunday, and the winners will be announced every Saturday.
content:
📢 PG-MALL Large Cash Voucher Lucky Draw – Participation Details

Dear PG Employees, to thank you for your continued support and trust, we are launching a Large Cash Voucher Lucky Draw. Everyone is warmly invited to participate.

📌 I. Participation Slots
✅ Total of 8 order pools
✅ Each pool holds 50 participants
✅ Total of 400 slots — First Come, First Served

📌 II. How to Participate
💰 Each entry costs 20 ETB
🔄 One employee can participate unlimited times (increases winning chances)

📌 III. Prize Mechanism (Fair & Transparent)
🎲 Winners are randomly selected by system
📊 Each pool produces 1 winner per 50 orders
🏆 Total of 8 winners (across 8 pools)

📌 IV. Result Announcement & Prize Claim
📅 Results announced this Saturday in all discussion groups
✉️ Winners must send their order number in the group
⏰ Prize must be claimed within 24 hours of announcement (otherwise forfeited)
❤️ Unclaimed prizes will be donated to the International Red Cross

📌 V. Refund (for non-winners)
🔄 The 20 ETB payment will be fully refunded by Sunday — no action needed

📌 VI. Important Notes
🔹 Final interpretation belongs to the PG-MALL Operations Team
🔹 Activity may be suspended, adjusted, or cancelled due to technical issues
🔹 If you fail to claim due to personal error (wrong order number, missed announcement), you bear the responsibility
🔹 Vouchers are for personal use only — non-transferable, non-exchangeable
🔹 Participation means you have read, understood, and agreed to all terms

❓ Questions? Ask in the discussion groups.
🍀 Good luck to everyone!
